title_zh: 英国服务票据｜清晰 PDF
description_en: Primary UK example: a fictional kitchen mixer tap replacement by Cedar Home Services, with technician James Turner, a Bristol service address and a GBP 240 total.
description_zh: 英国主要示例：虚构的 Cedar Home Services 厨房混水龙头更换票据，列有技师 James Turner、Bristol 服务地址和 GBP 240 总额。
expected_handling_en: Expected, to verify: preview the PDF and clearly offer manual entry in the current prototype. Review any manually entered fields before confirmation; save only after the user confirms. Do not describe the PDF as automatically recognised.
expected_handling_zh: 待核对的预期：预览 PDF，并明确提示当前原型需手工填写；人工录入后先核对，再由用户确认保存。不得把 PDF 描述为已经自动识别。
provenance_en: Original program-generated fictional PDF. Names, address and prices are invented for software testing; it is not a real customer document.
provenance_zh: 通过程序原创生成的虚构 PDF；姓名、地址和价格均为软件测试数据，不是真实客户单据。

title_zh: 英国服务票据｜清晰 PNG
description_en: Image version of the clear UK PDF, suitable for comparing the image-upload path with the PDF path. It contains the same fictional GBP 240 service details.
description_zh: 清晰英国 PDF 的图片版本，便于比较图片上传与 PDF 上传流程；包含相同的虚构 GBP 240 服务信息。
expected_handling_en: Expected, to verify: show readable service details for review, keep the company, technician and customer roles separate, and distinguish service date from issue date. Allow corrections and save only after explicit confirmation.
expected_handling_zh: 待核对的预期：把可读服务信息展示给用户核对，分开公司、技师与客户角色，区分服务日期与开票日期；允许修改，明确确认后才保存。
provenance_en: PNG rendered from the fictional UK PDF. This is a digital test document, not a scan or a phone photograph of a real receipt.
provenance_zh: 由虚构英国 PDF 渲染的 PNG；属于数字测试文档，不是真实票据的扫描件或手机实拍照片。

title_zh: 英国票据｜模拟手机随拍
description_en: Primary UK photo example: a fictional GBP 240 receipt on a wooden table, with slight perspective, creases and shadows. This simulates a phone snapshot; it is not an actual phone photograph.
description_zh: 英国主要照片示例：木桌上的虚构 GBP 240 票据，带轻微透视、折痕和阴影。它模拟手机随拍效果，并非手机实拍。
expected_handling_en: Expected, to verify: retain whatever details are readable in this image, flag uncertain or missing fields, and let the uploader compare and correct the result before confirming. Do not fill fields from the clean sample automatically.
expected_handling_zh: 待核对的预期：保留本图实际可读的信息，提示不确定或缺失字段，让上传者对照图片、修改并确认；不得自动从清晰样本复制字段。
provenance_en: AI-generated with the built-in image_gen tool, using a fictional receipt reference. The image visibly states FICTIONAL TEST DATA; no real client document was photographed.
provenance_zh: 使用内置 image_gen 工具和虚构票据参考图生成，图中保留 FICTIONAL TEST DATA 标识，没有拍摄真实客户单据。

title_en: Partly blurred simulated phone photo — AED example
title_zh: 部分模糊的模拟随拍｜AED 补充样本
description_en: Supplementary international sample for capture-quality and format diversity: motion blur and glare affect a fictional AED receipt. Some large text remains visible. It is an AI simulation, not a real phone photo.
description_zh: 用于拍摄质量和格式多样性的国际补充样本：虚构 AED 票据受到运动模糊与眩光影响，部分较大文字仍可见。它是 AI 模拟图，不是手机实拍。
expected_handling_en: Expected, to verify: preserve any usable partial result and mark uncertain fields for review. If too little is readable, offer a clearer upload or manual entry. The blurred appearance does not predict which fields OCR will recover, and no result should be saved automatically.
expected_handling_zh: 待核对的预期：保留可用的部分结果，并提示核对不确定字段；若可读信息太少，则提供重传清晰图片或手工填写入口。不能仅凭模糊外观预判 OCR 能读出哪些字段，也不得自动保存。
provenance_en: AI-generated degraded variant of an earlier fictional AED receipt photo simulation. Retained as a supplementary format example; the UK examples remain the main audience reference.
provenance_zh: 由早期虚构 AED 票据模拟照片生成的模糊版本，仅保留为格式补充示例；英国样本仍是主要受众示例。

title_zh: 内容可读但字段缺失的票据
description_en: A fictional electrical repair receipt with visible company, address and work details, but no service date, total, currency or named worker. This earlier international fixture adds a different incomplete-document format.
description_zh: 虚构电气维修票据，公司、地址和工作内容可读，但没有服务日期、总额、币种或具名施工者。这份早期国际样本用于补充缺字段的文档格式。
expected_handling_en: Expected, to verify: retain the readable details, leave absent values blank and show what is missing. Do not invent a date, set the amount to zero, infer currency from the address or treat the customer as the worker. Allow review and explicit confirmation.
expected_handling_zh: 待核对的预期：保留可读内容，缺失值留空并明确提示；不得虚构日期、把金额设为零、根据地址推断币种，或把客户当作施工者。允许核对后明确确认。
provenance_en: Original fictional SVG partial-copy document rendered to PNG. It contains no actual customer information and is not a photograph.
provenance_zh: 原创虚构 SVG 残缺票据渲染而成的 PNG，不含真实客户信息，也不是照片。

description_en: A synthetic receipt image deliberately rendered with severe blur and low contrast to test the recovery path when no reliable details are readable.
description_zh: 刻意以严重模糊和低对比度渲染的合成票据图片，用于检验无法可靠读取信息时的恢复流程。
expected_handling_en: Expected, to verify: explain that no usable receipt details were found and offer a clearer file or manual entry. Do not show preset details, claim successful recognition or create a saved record automatically.
expected_handling_zh: 待核对的预期：提示未找到可用票据信息，并提供更换清晰文件或手工填写入口；不得展示预设字段、宣称识别成功或自动生成已保存记录。
provenance_en: Original fictional SVG receipt rendered with an SVG blur filter and reduced contrast. No real photograph or private document was used.
provenance_zh: 原创虚构 SVG 票据通过 SVG 模糊滤镜和降低对比度渲染生成，未使用真实照片或私人单据。

title_zh: 无关的餐馆收据｜AED 补充样本
description_en: A clear fictional restaurant receipt with food items and an AED 124 total. This international format example tests relevance to property-service history, rather than image clarity.
description_zh: 清晰的虚构餐馆收据，列有餐品和 AED 124 总额。这份国际格式样本用于检验内容是否属于房屋服务历史，而不是检验图片清晰度。
expected_handling_en: Expected, to verify: explain that the readable document appears unrelated to property work, or ask the uploader to clarify its relevance if uncertain. Do not call it blurry, treat the restaurant address as a serviced home or save it automatically as a home repair.
expected_handling_zh: 待核对的预期：说明这份可读文档似乎与房屋工作无关；如无法确定，则让上传者说明关联。不得称其模糊、把餐馆地址当作施工房屋，或自动保存为房屋维修记录。
provenance_en: Original fictional restaurant-receipt SVG rendered to PNG. Retained only as a supplementary international format and relevance test; it is not a real purchase record.
provenance_zh: 原创虚构餐馆收据 SVG 渲染为 PNG，仅保留为国际格式与内容相关性补充测试，不是真实消费记录。

description_en: A clear synthetic landscape with hills, trees and a lake, containing no receipt text or transaction details.
description_zh: 清晰的合成风景图片，包含山丘、树木和湖泊，没有票据文字或交易信息。
expected_handling_en: Expected, to verify: state that no usable receipt details were found and offer a relevant document upload or manual entry. Do not invent a service or claim the image is blurry. A no-text OCR result alone must not be presented as proof that the system recognised a landscape.
expected_handling_zh: 待核对的预期：提示未找到可用票据信息，提供上传相关文档或手工填写入口；不得虚构服务或称图片模糊。仅凭 OCR 未读到文字，不能宣称系统已经识别出风景。
provenance_en: New synthetic landscape generated with the built-in image_gen tool. It is not a photograph from a real customer or a verified real location.
provenance_zh: 通过内置 image_gen 工具新生成的合成风景图，不是真实客户提供的照片，也不是经核实的真实地点。
